results.title: Tshisekedi and Ruto meet in Congo-Brazzaville to resolve DR Congo-Kenya rift
results.content: DRC President Félix Tshisekedi met his Kenyan counterpart William Ruto during a mini summit hosted in Congo-Brazzaville on Sunday. The two leaders pledged further relations after years of tensions over the DRC-Rwanda crisis.

results.title: Indonesia: Rescuers recover 24 body bags from burnt-out factory
results.content: A devastating fire has gutted a confectionery factory near Jakarta, with authorities recovering 24 body bags from the wreckage. Rescue workers continue searching for missing employees as investigators examine the cause.

results.title: UN calls for probe after drone attacks hit ships off Libya
results.content: There was no immediate claim of responsibility for either strike on Sunday off the port city of Benghazi, but they came as Ukrainian forces stepped up attacks against Russia far from the front lines.

results.title: Brazil: Colourful costumes and dancing take over Copacabana Pride
results.content: Thousands of people filled Copacabana's beachfront in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on Sunday 22 November 2026, for the city's 31st Pride Parade, celebrating LGBT+ diversity and calling for greater equality.

results.title: Drone strikes hit homes and UN premises in Sudan's capital
results.content: The United Nations confirmed that one of its premises, with UN personnel inside, was damaged in the attacks. It condemned the risks posed to humanitarian workers in civilian areas.

results.title: Morocco: A surreal sculpture park turns the world upside down
results.content: An upside-down house, giant furniture and vegetable-headed figures await visitors at Ramakech, an 11-hectare sculpture park near Marrakech, where French artist Jean-François Fourtou brings childhood memories to life through extraordinary, larger-than-life installations.

results.title: Egypt record first win, Mozambique fall in Under-17 World Cup
results.content: Egypt and Mozambique are both second in their groups, each with three points. They will need wins in their final group matches to strengthen their chances of reaching the next round.

results.title: Muhoozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw
results.content: MuhUganda were held to a goalless draw by Ecuador in their second Group B match at the FIFA U-17 World Cup on Sunday, leaving the Cranes needing a win in their final group game to reach the round of 32.oozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw.

results.title: United Nations COP31 climate talks collapse in bitter row over fossil fuels
results.content: European nations, as well as many smaller climate-vulnerable countries rejected the draft deal which failed to mention fossil fuels.

results.title: West Bank: Four Palestinian villages targeted in suspected settler attacks
results.content: Burnt-out cars, damaged trucks and anti-Arab graffiti were discovered in four Palestinian villages in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday 22 November 2026, following overnight attacks blamed by local activists on Israeli settlers.

results.title: Drought strains Mauritius' agricultural sector pushing up food prices
results.content: El Nino-driven heat and the severe drought have slashed crop yields, raised irrigation costs, and sent food prices soaring.

results.title: Ex-opposition leader to stand as independent in Burundi's presidential poll
results.content: Agathon Rwasa was ousted as leader of the National Congress for Freedom party in March 2024 by dissident MPs.

results.title: Generations of Palestinians displaced by earlier conflicts live in limbo in Egypt
results.content: They face hurdles accessing education, healthcare, and other public services as they are considered foreigners.

results.title: African football reaffirms support for re-election of FIFA's Gianni Infantino
results.content: CAF has been consistently behind Gianni Infantino who is seeking a controversial fourth term to 2031, despite criticism of his leadership.

results.title: Ukraine: Up to seven feared trapped beneath rubble near Kyiv after Russian attack
results.content: A Russian strike partially destroyed an apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, on Sunday. Nine people, including a child, were evacuated as rescuers searched the rubble for up to seven others feared trapped.

results.title: Japan: Mascot mania takes over Saitama with 200 colourful characters
results.content: More than 200 colourful mascots gathered in Saitama, Japan, delighting tens of thousands of fans with dancing, parades and photo opportunities. Among the stars was Kumamon, the country's famous black bear mascot.

results.title: Portugal: Workers brave downpours to demand a more affordable life
results.content: Thousands of people marched through Lisbon, Portugal, on Saturday 21 November 2026, braving heavy rain to demand higher wages, better pensions and measures to tackle the rising cost of living. The demonstration came just days before Portugal's parliamentary budget vote.

results.title: Nations agree to further talks on regulating AI 'killer robots and drones'
results.content: The weakened agreement reached at the UN talks did not, however, commit to reaching binding rules to rein them in.

results.title: Zimbabwean author cleared of using AI to write prize-winning story
results.content: Simbarashe Kundizeza says he is 'relieved and happy' after a month-long investigation found his entry was human-written.

results.title: Ukraine: Dashcam captures massive explosion on Lviv street
results.content: A dashcam captured the moment a Russian projectile struck a building directly ahead of a car in Lviv, forcing the driver to reverse. The attack killed two people and injured at least 10 others.

results.title: Cameroon U17s fall to Venezuela in World Cup opener
results.content: Cameroon’s U17 team began their FIFA U17 World Cup campaign in Doha with a 2-1 defeat to Venezuela, leaving the players and coach Thomas Libiih looking to regroup ahead of their next Group K match.

results.title: Tanzania rally from two goals down to draw with Costa Rica in U17 World Cup debut
results.content: Tanzania’s U17 side fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Costa Rica in their FIFA U17 World Cup debut in Doha.

results.title: Senegal's Dak'Art Biennale explores themes of resilience and rebound
results.content: The contemporary African art exhibition's official selection brings together 54 artists from 17 African countries, and runs until 19 December.

results.title: A road trip along South Africa's legendary Route 62
results.content: The 850 km drive stretches between Cape Town in the Western Cape and Gqeberha in the Eastern Cape, passing through numerous small historic towns.

results.title: French police officers sentenced to jail for assaulting Black music producer
results.content: In a landmark ruling, a court gave all three men five years in prison with varying portions suspended, finding racism an aggravated factor.

results.title: English captain and Bayern Munich star out of action after ankle injury
results.content: Striker Harry Kane vows to be back for ‘business end of season’ after surgery on a ligament in his ankle which he tore during a match on Friday.

results.title: Strait of Hormuz: Athlete swims through war zone to expose war's environmental toll
results.content: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh completed a 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz over three days in November 2026, braving explosions and burning tankers nearby. His three-day challenge aimed to expose the environmental damage caused by the war with Iran.

results.title: South Africa's former vice president and UN official dies aged 71
results.content: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka was the country's first deputy president and headed UN Women from 2013 to 2021.

results.title: Morocco commits €366 million to build a national defence industry by 2035
results.content: The roadmap will be backed by a new strategic agency responsible for implementing national defence industry policy and supporting investors

results.title: Japan: Autonomous air taxi completes passenger flight without a pilot
results.content: A pilotless electric flying taxi has carried a passenger during a demonstration, on Friday 20 November 2026, in Japan's Yamanashi Prefecture. The Chinese-built aircraft took off vertically and flew autonomously, offering a glimpse of a possible future for urban transport.
